config.title: Source Insight Lite
config.include: Glob for files that belong to the project.
config.headerLanguage: Grammar used to parse .h files. The C++ grammar is a superset and is usually the safer choice.
config.indexReferences: Record every identifier use so Find References works without a language server. Turn off for very large projects to save memory.
config.autoBuildOnOpen: Synchronize the project database automatically when a workspace opens.
config.relationDepth: Default depth for the relation graph.
config.relationFollowCursor: Relation view follows the symbol under the cursor.
config.maxGraphNodes: Upper bound on nodes rendered in the relation graph.
config.ignoreMacros: Decorator macros blanked out before parsing (attribute-like words that sit between the type and the name, e.g. av_cold, __init). Add your project's own; case-sensitive whole words.
config.provideHover: Show symbol signature and location on hover.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
config.language: Language for messages, the Context view and the Relations panel. Command names and settings follow the VS Code display language.
cmd.findReferencesInFile: SI: Find References In This File
config.semanticHighlighting: Colour identifiers by what the project database says they are (macros, globals, parameters, fields, types). Needs the editor setting editor.semanticHighlighting.enabled.
cmd.searchProject: SI: Search Project (functions using all given symbols)
config.parallelism: Parse threads used by a full build. 0 = automatic (CPU count minus 2, at most 4).
config.sourceInsightKeys: Source Insight style keys: Ctrl+= jump to definition, Ctrl+/ lookup references (replaces toggle comment in C/C++), Alt+, / Alt+. go back / forward, F7 project symbol list, F8 file symbol list.
config.externalPaths: Absolute directories outside the workspace to index as well (SDK, HAL, toolchain headers). Like Source Insight external libraries: their symbols show up in navigation, completion and the Context view.
config.excludePaths: Files and folders removed from the project explicitly (absolute paths). Managed by "SI: Remove from Project".
